scope: verify an explicitly selected CLTR checkpoint reference against an explicitly supplied local file

checks.match: compare a 30-byte target and a 131329-byte target against independently computed SHA-256 values
checks.mismatch: reject same-length changed bytes, shorter and longer targets, and missing or nonregular files
checks.selection: select by exact chunk sequence; reject absent sequences, non-reference chunks, invalid numbers, and incomplete or corrupt traces before reporting success
checks.compatibility: keep existing trace fixture hashes unchanged; run release, ASan/UBSan and substrate-free installed checks

limits: verify byte identity only; no checkpoint decoding, state restore, or research run
